items.title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
items.summary: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.

items.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
items.summary: The best thing industry leaders can do is to invest the time to ensure this country’s policymakers can experience the technology they’re regulating up close, writes Allie Page, executive director of American Innovation P

items.title: Nvidia shares plunge 10% to June 2025 levels as Jensen Huang resigns
items.summary: CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO after Huang steps down immediately as president, chief executive and board member, sending shares down 10% to $156.

items.title: Bitcoin weakness erases September's bullish signal
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 12, 2026

items.title: UK bank Griffin raises $20 million to expand into stablecoin payments
items.summary: The Series B funding round, led by Octagon Partners valued the London-based company at more than $100 million.

items.title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
items.summary: Ethlabs wants quantum-resistant accounts targeted for next year, even if wallet holders still have to switch signing methods themselves.

items.title: Bitcoin dips with Nvidia as ETF outflows reach day five
items.summary: Bitcoin slips 0.7% as Nvidia falls on reports its board may oust CEO Jensen Huang, while U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lose another $299.9 million.

items.title: Polymarket trims workforce under investor pressure as Kalshi surges ahead
items.summary: More than half of those affected were contractors, a source told Reuters. The cuts follow investor pressure on founder Shayne Coplan.

items.title: Nomura weighs Laser Digital sale as European losses hit four straight quarters
items.summary: The Japanese brokerage has held talks with potential buyers, including Marex, as its European business posts more losses.

items.title: India’s financial crimes watchdog raids crypto exchanges CoinDCX and Delta over alleged illegal cross-border trades
items.summary: The Enforcement Directorate alleged illegal cross-border flows that violated India's foreign exchange laws.

items.title: Bitcoin slides toward $71K as Nvidia stock tumbles after Huang steps down
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest leve since Aug. 20 as tech stocks slid following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
items.summary: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

items.title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
items.summary: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.

items.title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
items.summary: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

items.title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
items.summary: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.

items.title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
items.summary: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

items.title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
items.summary: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.

items.title: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec
items.summary: Coinbase’s EU policy chief says applying suitability tests beyond crypto lending and borrowing could limit access and fragment liquidity.

items.title: Stablecoin supply falls $14.2B in biggest 30-day drop since June 2022
items.summary: Crypto markets were left with “less fuel” to rally after the market cap of major stablecoins saw its biggest 30-day drop in over four years.

items.title: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds
items.summary: The group will focus on illicit USDT activity on Tron and help law enforcement investigate suspicious transfers and freeze funds faster.

items.title: Illinois Crypto Tax Draws Unlikely Alliance of DOJ, Banks and DeFi
items.summary: The DOJ, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, SIFMA and a crypto coalition led by a16z, Paradigm and Uniswap filed briefs backing a lawsuit to strike down the state’s 0.2% levy on digital asset transactions.

items.title: 'A Massive Mistake': Tech, AI and Crypto Founders React to Jensen Huang’s Nvidia Exit
items.summary: Nvidia’s founder is out, and tech and crypto leaders are fuming. Some fear for open-source AI, others question the board, while Elon Musk says he’d be honored to hire Huang.

items.title: Tron, Tether and Chainalysis Form a New Crypto-Crime Task Force—Replacing One That Just Collapsed
items.summary: The Digital Crime Task Force aims to proactively trace illicit USDT on Tron and freeze funds before they move—just weeks after the trio’s near-identical T3 unit, built with rival firm TRM Labs, quietly collapsed.

items.title: Anchorage Digital’s Stablecoins Can Now Settle Payments on Visa’s Network
items.summary: Visa and eligible companies can now use Western Union’s USDPT—issued and custodied by the federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank—to settle VisaNet obligations.

items.title: Tether Gold Gets Clean KPMG Audit Confirming $2.2B in Physical Gold Backing
items.summary: KPMG counted every gold bar behind XAUT, making it Tether's second stablecoin to complete a full audit by a Big Four accounting firm.

items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO, With CFO Colette Kress Named Interim Chief
items.summary: The Nvidia co-founder steps down after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company executive, ending his 33-year run.

items.title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
items.summary: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

items.title: DTCC to Bring Tokenized Stocks and Treasuries to Solana in 2027
items.summary: Wall Street's main settlement firm will add Solana to its tokenization service, which went live last month on Canton and a private network.

items.title: Morning Minute: Tokenized Stock Venues Are Launching Without Big Tech’s Approval
items.summary: Plus, a second Jensen Huang affair is rocking markets while MSCI’s MSTR removal decision sends crypto lower.

items.title: India's Financial Crimes Agency Searches CoinDCX, Delta Exchange Over Offshore Trades
items.summary: The Enforcement Directorate alleges the exchanges routed Indian users' trades to Binance, Bybit and others via a Costa Rican shell entity.
